portraits.prompt:
Create ONE game-ready character portrait asset, not a sheet. Historical Age of Sail RPG, a mature adult German tavern waitress, age 30. Use Image 1 as the face, hair and expression reference. Image 2 is only the game's PAINTED ART STYLE and transparent-cutout format reference, never copy its face or hairstyle. Match the game's crisp refined semi-realistic painted character art with delicate visible brushwork, clean readable light, rich local fabric colors and detailed embroidery. The adult face must faithfully carry reference 1's eye shape, nose, lips, expression, head angle and distinctive hair. Ordinary fully opaque tavern serving dress with fitted lace-up bodice, linen blouse, waist apron and skirt. Moderate square neckline and natural adult proportions. Composition: a SINGLE character with COMPLETE head and hair through BOTH KNEES, crop immediately below knees, NO shins, boots or feet. Tall 2:3 canvas, character centered, about 94 percent of canvas height, 4 percent top margin, hands and hair fully inside side edges. Both shoulders, torso, hips and thighs visible. True transparent alpha background: no scenery, no wall, no table, no stool, no background figures, no vignette, no text, no border, no panels, no floor shadow. The relaxed gesture may suggest the reference pose without furniture. Clear detailed face readable in a game conversation window.
Character: Long tousled dark honey-blonde hair, oval face, softly parted lips, serious alert sideways and upward gaze, three-quarter head angle. Ivory blouse, brown leather bodice, russet skirt and linen apron, simple pendant. Stand next to tavern table with one forearm resting.
Important: retain this character's face, hair, and facial expression, but no furniture or scenery. Any supported-hand pose should be held comfortably in the air or against her own forearm, with a fully visible silhouette.

Edit the attached GAME CHARACTER ART into a revised single game-ready knee-up portrait, preserving this same adult tavern waitress's identity, facial features, light freckles, blue-gray eyes, short tousled curly golden-blonde bob and gentle attentive closed-mouth expression.
